name: github-stars-wheel
title: GitHub Stars Wheel
description: A vertical odometer of numbers races upward and lands on a GitHub repository's star total. A star in the highlighted row fills yellow, and small particles burst when it settles.
use: You want to show a repository star total with a bit of celebration on a landing page.
avoid: The exact number matters before the animation ends, or users dislike motion; the wheel delays it.
a11y: Star icons are aria-hidden and the changing numbers are not announced; no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two stacked number wheels on a dark background, each showing a column of grey figures with one bold highlighted row in a bordered pill that holds a star. The repo name sits in small grey text below.
behaves: On view, the numbers roll upward like an odometer and slow to a stop at the target. The star fills from the bottom as the count climbs and sparks a short particle burst when it finishes.
customise: Pass value with step, direction, delay and item sizing; or give a username and repo to fetch the count live. Colours and particle geometry are in the source.
weight: light: A short list of number rows on a spring plus a handful of particles; it settles after the run.
